content:
We're happy to announce the conference Lean for the Curious Mathematician 2026 that will take place in Cortona, Italy, 7-12 September 2026. The format follows that of previous events in the series, with research talks by

  • @Nirvana Coppola
  • @Floris van Doorn
  • @Christian Merten
  • Marco Pedicini

and most of the rest of the time devoted to tutorials and practical sessions.

Registration is mandatory and there are only 45 places available. The deadline for applications is April 15th. Hotels for all selected participants will be fully funded, and there is partial support for young researchers. Please be aware that the the goal of the event is to promote the use of Lean and Mathlib particularly among non-experts, so experienced users will be given lower priority. But they can help us spread the word!

Organizing committee

  • @Fabrizio Barroero , Università degli Studi Roma Tre
  • @Laura Capuano , Università degli Studi Roma Tre
  • @Alessandro Iraci , Università Telematica Pegaso
  • @Giovanni Paolini , Alma Mater Studiorum - Università di Bologna
  • @Amos Turchet , Università degli Studi Roma Tre
  • @Francesco Veneziano , Università degli Studi di Genova

Scientific Committee

  • @Riccardo Brasca , Université Paris Cité
  • @Kevin Buzzard , Imperial College London
  • @Marco Lenci , Alma Mater Studiorum - Università di Bologna
  • @Filippo A. E. Nuccio, Inria and Université Jean Monnet Saint-Étienne
The deadline has been postponed until the end of April, and there still are some free slots, so if you think you might be interested, do not hesitate to register!

We do! Following my previous message we've received several more applications, so I cannot promise anything right now. But you're certainly welcome to submit your application and we'll soon be back with an answer.
